name: TikTok Shop Affiliate / Creator

yield.notes: Affiliate commissions typically 5-20%. Requires consistent content creation (semi-active, not passive).

startup_checklist: Create TikTok Creator account and apply for TikTok Shop affiliate program
Choose product niche aligned with your content style
Post first 30 videos in 30 days to establish cadence and test what works
Add product links to videos as soon as affiliate access is approved
Track click-through and conversion rates by product
failure_modes: TikTok banned or restricted in US market
kill_criteria: Less than $100/month after 90 days of consistent posting
sources_note: Commission rates from TikTok Shop affiliate program documentation.
